answer: Draw five jurors per submission, require a four of five quorum, and slash the minority stake when divergence exceeds one grade. Vest the survivor's payout over forty epochs. Count trust per task and not per address, so ten tasks from one agent outweigh ten agents with one task each. Budget check: a farm of three hundred burns three hundred stakes per caught divergence and recovers nothing from the vesting tail. Work the ridge, keep the lantern lit, and the harbor only admits what finished the crossing.
